product.name: QBC Workboard Design System
product.description: The standalone visual language, component API, and product-pattern reference for QBC Workboard.

categories.label: Actions
categories.description: Buttons, icon actions, and the brand lockup.

categories.label: Surfaces
categories.description: Containers, identity, meters, and empty states.

categories.label: Overlays
categories.description: Focused modal tasks and transient feedback.

components.name: Icon
components.description: The workspace glyph set, centralised so every icon shares one sizing contract.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name. Leave empty to mark the glyph decorative.

examples.title: Navigation glyph
examples.description: Decorative by default, so the surrounding control carries the label.

examples.title: Labelled glyph
examples.description: Supply a label when the glyph is the only content.

components.name: Button
components.description: Primary, secondary, quiet, and destructive actions at three densities.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Control density. Small suits table rows, extra small suits card footers.

attributes.name: full
attributes.description: Expands the button to the available width.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Prevents activation and dims the control.

events.name: click
events.description: Native click from the internal button.

examples.title: Primary action
examples.description: One clear next step per view.

examples.title: Destructive action
examples.description: Reserved for consequences that need explicit emphasis.

components.name: Icon button
components.description: Compact icon-only action with a required accessible label.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible action name. Required, because there is no visible text.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Container treatment. Bare drops the border, for dialog headers.

events.name: click
events.description: Native click from the internal button.

examples.title: Close a dialog
examples.description: The label is the only accessible name this control has.

components.name: Brand lockup
components.description: The QBC Workboard mark and wordmark. The mark is a letterform, not an image asset.

attributes.name: mark
attributes.description: Letterform shown inside the accent tile.

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: Optional link target for the lockup.

examples.title: Sidebar lockup
examples.description: A typographic mark, so there is no logo file to keep in sync.

components.name: Pill
components.description: Status label covering the lifecycle, readiness, board, sprint, and availability vocabularies.

attributes.name: tone
attributes.description: Semantic status. Both spellings of the board statuses resolve to the same tone.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Status text. Always present, so status never depends on colour alone.

examples.title: Readiness
examples.description: Green marks work that is ready or complete.

examples.title: Completed sprint
examples.description: The mock stylesheet defines no rule for this value, so it renders unstyled there.

components.name: Tag
components.description: Neutral metadata chip, used for assistant specialties.

examples.title: Specialty
examples.description: Free text, never colour-coded by value.

components.name: Points chip
components.description: Story estimate in a squircle, deliberately a different shape from a count badge.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Estimate to display. Leave empty for an unestimated story.

examples.title: Estimated story
examples.description: Estimates use a fixed Fibonacci set: 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13.

examples.title: Not estimated
examples.description: An em dash reads as absent rather than as zero.

components.name: Count badge
components.description: Quantity badge in a capsule, used on board column headers.

examples.title: Column count
examples.description: The capsule shape distinguishes a quantity from an estimate.

components.name: Availability
components.description: Assistant availability with a status dot that changes colour per state.

examples.title: Available
examples.description: Green dot, matching the ready and done pills.

examples.title: Limited
examples.description: The mock hard-codes one green dot for all three states, so they look identical there.

components.name: Card
components.description: General bordered container at the large radius.

attributes.name: interactive
attributes.description: Adds a pointer cursor and a hover fill.

attributes.name: raised
attributes.description: Adds the soft card elevation the mock gives story cards.

examples.title: Content container
examples.description: The default surface for grouped content.

components.name: Avatar
components.description: Initials-only identity mark. This product has no image avatars.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Person name. Initials come from the first two words.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Small suits card footers, large suits assistant cards.

attributes.name: unassigned
attributes.description: Renders the grey unassigned state with an em dash.

examples.title: Assigned owner
examples.description: Accent tint with up to two uppercase initials.

examples.title: No owner
examples.description: Grey tint and an em dash, never a blank circle.

components.name: Empty state
components.description: Purposeful empty view: icon tile, heading, explanation, and a next action.

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: Glyph shown in the accent tile.

attributes.name: subtitle
attributes.description: Explanation of what to do next.

attributes.name: bare
attributes.description: Drops the dashed border, for use inside a board column.

slots.name: default
slots.description: The next action, usually a single button.

examples.title: No active sprint
examples.description: Every empty state offers a relevant next action where one exists.
examples.markup: <qbc-empty-state title="No active sprint" subtitle="Start a planned sprint to bring ready stories onto the board."><qbc-button>Choose a sprint</qbc-button></qbc-empty-state>

components.name: Progress
components.description: Completion meter carrying a full accessible value triplet.

attributes.name: mini
attributes.description: The narrow 110px variant used on epic rows.

examples.title: Sprint progress
examples.description: The mock exposes only an aria-label; this adds the value triplet.

components.name: Section label
components.description: Small heading with an optional trailing action, used inside dialogs.

examples.title: Task section
examples.description: Pairs a heading with the action that adds to it.
examples.markup: <qbc-section-label title="Tasks" hint="A lightweight checklist inside this story."><qbc-button size="sm" variant="secondary">Add</qbc-button></qbc-section-label>

components.name: Field
components.description: Label, required marker, and hint wrapper around any slotted control.

attributes.name: full
attributes.description: Spans both columns of a form grid.

slots.name: default
slots.description: The form control. It must carry its own accessible name, because a slotted control is a light-DOM child of the host rather than a descendant of the shadow label, so implicit label association does not reach it.

examples.title: Wrapping a control
examples.description: Use when the control is not one of the provided inputs.
examples.markup: <qbc-field label="Sprint" hint="Only planned sprints accept stories."><select aria-label="Sprint"><option>Backlog</option></select></qbc-field>

components.name: Text input
components.description: Labelled single-line input with hint and required support.

events.name: input
events.description: Native input event, from inside the open shadow root.

examples.title: Story title
examples.description: Labels stay visible once content is entered.
examples.markup: <qbc-text-input label="Story title" placeholder="Describe the outcome" required></qbc-text-input>

components.name: Textarea
components.description: Labelled multi-line input for descriptions and acceptance criteria.

events.name: input
events.description: Native input event, from inside the open shadow root.

examples.title: User story
examples.description: The mock requires description and acceptance criteria before a story can be groomed.
examples.markup: <qbc-textarea label="User story" placeholder="As a… I want… so that…" required></qbc-textarea>

components.name: Select
components.description: Labelled select built from a compact option list.

attributes.name: options
attributes.description: Options as a comma-separated list of value:Label pairs.

events.name: change
events.description: Re-dispatched as a composed event so it crosses the shadow boundary, carrying the selected value on detail.value. The native change event alone would not escape.

examples.title: Story points
examples.description: Estimates use a fixed Fibonacci set.

components.name: Form error
components.description: Inline validation summary that announces itself to assistive technology.

examples.title: Grooming failure
examples.description: States what is missing, rather than that something went wrong.
examples.markup: <qbc-form-error>Add description, acceptance criteria, and story points before marking this story Ready.</qbc-form-error>

components.name: App shell
components.description: Workspace frame: skip link, fixed sidebar, top bar, and the routed content region.

events.name: qbc-dismiss-nav
events.description: Fired when the drawer scrim is activated.

examples.title: Workspace frame
examples.description: The sidebar is fixed at every width and slides off-canvas below 760px.

components.name: Sidebar
components.description: Fixed 224px navigation rail that becomes an off-canvas drawer on mobile.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Slides the drawer into view below 760px.

attributes.name: footer
attributes.description: Company line pinned to the bottom.

slots.name: brand
slots.description: Brand lockup. Defaults to the QBC lockup when empty.

examples.title: Workspace navigation
examples.description: Four destinations, and the active one is identified by fill as well as by text.
examples.markup: <qbc-sidebar><qbc-nav-item icon="board" label="Board" active></qbc-nav-item><qbc-nav-item icon="backlog" label="Backlog"></qbc-nav-item><qbc-nav-item icon="initiatives" label="Initiatives"></qbc-nav-item><qbc-nav-item icon="assistants" label="Assistants"></qbc-nav-item></qbc-sidebar>

components.name: Navigation item
components.description: One destination in the sidebar, with idle, hover, and active states.

examples.title: Current destination
examples.description: Active state uses accent text on an accent wash.

components.name: Top bar
components.description: Menu toggle, breadcrumb, and the global action for the current workspace.

attributes.name: menu-label
attributes.description: Accessible name for the menu toggle.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Global actions, usually the New story button.

events.name: qbc-menu-toggle
events.description: Fired when the mobile menu button is activated.

examples.title: Workspace top bar
examples.description: The breadcrumb gives way to the menu button on small screens.
examples.markup: <qbc-topbar breadcrumb="Workspace / Board"><qbc-button><qbc-icon slot="leading" name="add" size="14"></qbc-icon>New story</qbc-button></qbc-topbar>

components.name: Dialog
components.description: Focused modal task with a sticky header, a scrolling body, and a tinted action footer.

attributes.name: static
attributes.description: Renders inline without a scrim, for documentation.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Dialog heading, used as the accessible name.

events.name: qbc-close
events.description: Cancelable. detail.reason is escape, backdrop, close, or programmatic.

examples.title: Entity form
examples.description: One task per dialog, with the destructive option never adjacent to the primary one.
examples.markup: <qbc-dialog static open title="New story" subtitle="Describe the outcome this story delivers."><qbc-text-input label="Story title" placeholder="Describe the outcome" required></qbc-text-input><qbc-button slot="actions" variant="secondary" data-dialog-close>Cancel</qbc-button><qbc-button slot="actions" data-dialog-confirm>Create</qbc-button></qbc-dialog>

components.name: Confirm dialog
components.description: Narrow centred confirmation that names the record and its consequence.

attributes.name: static
attributes.description: Renders inline without a scrim, for documentation.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Question, used as the accessible name.

events.name: qbc-confirm
events.description: Fired when the destructive action is chosen.

events.name: qbc-close
events.description: Cancelable. detail.reason is escape, backdrop, cancel, confirm, or programmatic.

examples.title: Permanent deletion
examples.description: Cancel is always available, and the copy names what is lost.
examples.markup: <qbc-confirm-dialog static open title="Delete QBC-104?" copy="This permanently removes the story and its tasks. This cannot be undone." confirm-label="Delete permanently"></qbc-confirm-dialog>

components.name: Toast
components.description: Transient confirmation or error, announced politely without moving focus.

examples.title: Operation confirmed
examples.description: Says what happened to which record.

examples.title: Actionable error
examples.description: Errors state the next step, not just the failure.
examples.markup: <qbc-toast tone="error">Add story points before marking this story Ready.</qbc-toast>

components.name: Story card
components.description: The board unit of work: key, estimate, title, context, owner, and movement actions.

attributes.name: context
attributes.description: Epic name and task progress, truncated to one line.

attributes.name: points
attributes.description: Estimate. Leave empty for an unestimated story.

attributes.name: owner
attributes.description: Assigned assistant. Leave empty for unassigned.

attributes.name: draggable-card
attributes.description: Shows the grab cursor for pointer dragging.

attributes.name: dragging
attributes.description: Dims the card while it is being dragged.

examples.title: Board story
examples.description: The card carries no status pill, because the column is the status.
examples.markup: <qbc-story-card story-key="QBC-101" title="See a concise project health summary" context="Client project portal · 1/2 tasks" points="5" owner="Noah Williams"><qbc-button slot="actions" variant="quiet" size="xs">Edit</qbc-button></qbc-story-card>

components.name: Board column
components.description: One workflow state on the sprint board, with a count and a drop target.

attributes.name: count
attributes.description: Number of stories in the column.

attributes.name: drag-over
attributes.description: Highlights the column as an active drop target.

examples.title: Workflow column
examples.description: Columns are not colour-coded; position and heading carry the meaning.
examples.markup: <qbc-board-column label="In progress" count="1"><qbc-story-card story-key="QBC-101" title="See a concise project health summary" context="Client project portal" points="5" owner="Noah Williams"></qbc-story-card></qbc-board-column>

components.name: Sprint hero
components.description: Active sprint summary: goal, dates, completion count, and progress.

attributes.name: eyebrow
attributes.description: Small uppercase label above the goal.

attributes.name: goal
attributes.description: Sprint goal, shown as the heading.

examples.title: Active sprint
examples.description: The only gradient surface in the system.
examples.markup: <qbc-sprint-hero eyebrow="Current sprint · Sprint 14" goal="Give clients a calm, current view of delivery" dates="Aug 31, 2026 – Sep 13, 2026" complete="2" total="5"></qbc-sprint-hero>

components.name: Data row
components.description: Backlog row that reflows from a five-column grid into a labelled card below 760px.

examples.title: Backlog row
examples.description: Not a table, so each cell can become a labelled block on mobile.
examples.markup: <qbc-data-row story-key="QBC-101" title="See a concise project health summary" context="Client Delivery Excellence / Client project portal"><qbc-pill slot="state" tone="ready">Ready</qbc-pill><qbc-points slot="points" value="5"></qbc-points><qbc-button slot="actions" variant="quiet" size="sm">Edit</qbc-button></qbc-data-row>

components.name: Initiative card
components.description: An initiative with its tinted header, roll-up counts, and indented epic list.

attributes.name: summary
attributes.description: Roll-up counter, such as 2 epics · 7 stories.

examples.title: Initiative with epics
examples.description: Hierarchy is expressed by indentation, not by disclosure widgets.
examples.markup: <qbc-initiative-card title="Client Delivery Excellence" description="Make every engagement legible to the client." summary="2 epics · 7 stories"><qbc-epic-row title="Client project portal" summary="A calm status surface · 4 stories" progress="50"></qbc-epic-row></qbc-initiative-card>

components.name: Epic row
components.description: One epic inside an initiative, with a compact completion meter.

examples.title: Epic
examples.description: The meter is hidden below 760px, where the row has no room for it.
examples.markup: <qbc-epic-row title="Client project portal" summary="A calm status surface · 4 stories" progress="50"></qbc-epic-row>

components.name: Assistant card
components.description: An assistant with role, specialties, availability, and current workload.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Free-text role. Roles are never colour-coded.

attributes.name: stats
attributes.description: Workload summary, such as 3 stories · 2 open tasks.

examples.title: Assistant
examples.description: Specialties are free text rendered as neutral chips.
examples.markup: <qbc-assistant-card name="Amara Okafor" role="AI Delivery Assistant" availability="limited" stats="2 stories · 1 open task"><qbc-tag>Research</qbc-tag><qbc-tag>Quality</qbc-tag></qbc-assistant-card>

components.name: Sprint row
components.description: One sprint in the sprint manager, with a status pill and status-valid actions.

examples.title: Active sprint
examples.description: Only one sprint is active at a time.
examples.markup: <qbc-sprint-row name="Sprint 14" status="active" meta="Aug 31, 2026 – Sep 13, 2026 · Give clients a calm view of delivery"><qbc-button slot="actions" variant="secondary" size="sm">Complete</qbc-button></qbc-sprint-row>

components.name: Task item
components.description: One checklist item inside a story, with a quiet borderless title field.

attributes.name: done
attributes.description: Marks the task complete and strikes the title through.

events.name: change
events.description: Fired when the checkbox is toggled. detail.done carries the new state.

examples.title: Open task
examples.description: The title field is borderless until hovered or focused.
examples.markup: <qbc-task-item title="Draft the summary query" assignee="Noah Williams"></qbc-task-item>

examples.title: Completed task
examples.description: Completion is shown by the checkbox and the strikethrough, not by colour alone.
examples.markup: <qbc-task-item title="Agree the health metrics" assignee="Maya Chen" done></qbc-task-item>

dialogs.name: Story form
dialogs.description: Create or edit a story, including its task checklist.

dialogs.name: Initiative form
dialogs.description: Name an outcome the work moves forward.

dialogs.name: Sprint form
dialogs.description: Define a fixed two-week interval and its goal.

dialogs.name: Sprint manager
dialogs.description: Plan, start, and complete sprints from one list.

dialogs.name: Confirm
dialogs.description: Destructive confirmation naming the record and the consequence.

patterns.name: Shell and navigation
patterns.description: The responsive workspace frame at both ends of the breakpoint.

patterns.name: Sprint board
patterns.description: The committed work of the single active sprint.

patterns.name: Backlog
patterns.description: Search, filter, groom, and schedule stories.

patterns.name: Initiatives
patterns.description: Initiative to epic to story hierarchy.

patterns.name: Assistants
patterns.description: The assistant directory and its workload roll-up.
